lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters organized in a semi-regular matrix posterior to the gill region, showing a higher density of larger blobs in the mid-flank section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible along the upper flank, characterized by high-luminance upper edges and lower-intensity shadow gradients immediately ventral to the ridge lines.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs primarily concentrated along the basal and posterior margins of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular notch present on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; small white depigmentation mark on the leading edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density concentration of small, high-frequency white spots at the distal end of the pectoral fin, contrasting with larger, more spaced blobs at the fin base.
